_about: Public-domain Anthony John Maas, Jesuit scripture scholar and rector of Woodstock College, Maryland, for the Word Hoard: The Life of Jesus Christ according to the Gospel History, A Day in the Temple, Christ in Type and Prophecy, and his commentary on the Gospel according to Saint Matthew. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 133 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

maas-life-of-jesus: The life of Jesus Christ according to the Gospel history (St. Louis : B. Herder, 1891)
maas-day-in-temple: A day in the temple ([n. p.], 1892)
maas-christ-in-type: Christ in type and prophecy (New York : Benziger Brothers, 1893)
maas-matthew: The Gospel according to Saint Matthew with an explanatory and critical commentary (St. Louis : Herder, 1898)
